C0403.title: Exploiting XSS to Steal Cookies for Admin Session Hijacking
C0403.summary: On March 14, 2026, a security researcher set up an XSS attack environment by injecting a malicious script into a message board. When an administrator reviewed the message, the payload was triggered, stealing their cookie containing the PHPSESSID.
